title: Workbench dark technical presentation
note: The supplied workbench's colors, typography and density, extracted from its stylesheet into a named profile. This is the change point the plan reserves for color, material, typography and density: it alters realization only. It adds no component, changes no identity and moves no region. Decoration here is geometry-neutral — rules are drawn with inset box-shadow rather than borders, because a border participates in layout and would displace resolved geometry. Selectors here target the semantic testimony attributes the projector emits, not provider-declared component classes: the projector realizes `class` for containers and wrappers only, so a component-level class never reaches the document.

basis.note: Merged over the retained sidefx-ui HTML provider; the basis is pinned and digested at build time.

typography.note: Font metrics participate in measurement. Changing these requires new geometry evidence, not only a new profile.

geometryNeutrality.note: Every rule is an inset box-shadow. A CSS border participates in layout and shifts the padding box, which is the containing block for absolutely positioned children; the resolver owns that geometry.

overlay.note: Duration and easing belong to the shared presentation profile, not to the dialog declaration: a capability declares the motion intent, and the profile decides how long it takes. Under reduced motion the declared fallback is substituted and the transition is suppressed entirely.
